# `company.audit_events`

Append-only company command events with actor and request provenance.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this audit event. |
| `seq` | INTEGER | yes | — | unique | — | — | Monotonic database-local cursor assigned to this event. |
| `at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when the event was recorded. |
| `command` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Registered command that produced the event. |
| `actor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | User id that performed the command; null before an actor is available. |
| `actor_kind` | VARCHAR(8) | yes | — | — | — | — | Actor kind recorded for the command; null before an actor is available. |
| `on_behalf_of` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Human principal id for an agent action; otherwise null. |
| `interface` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface through which the command was received. |
| `client_name` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Client application name supplied by the command context. |
| `client_version` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | Client application version supplied by the command context. |
| `client_host` | VARCHAR(255) | no | — | — | — | — | Host name supplied by the command context. |
| `session_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Session identifier that groups related requests. |
| `request_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Identifier of the request that produced this event. |
| `idempotency_key` | VARCHAR(128) | yes | — | — | — | — | Caller-supplied idempotency key; null when absent. |
| `reason` | VARCHAR(140) | yes | — | — | — | — | Short reason supplied for the write; null when absent. |
| `directive_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Standing-instruction id cited by the write; null when absent. |
| `directive_code` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Standing-instruction code captured with the event; null when absent. |
| `source_ref` | VARCHAR(512) | yes | — | — | — | — | Caller-supplied reference to the source of the write; null when absent. |
| `summary` | VARCHAR(512) | no | — | — | — | — | Human-readable summary of what the command did. |
